subject: Follow-up: Redwood demo + next steps (economic buyer intro)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Joao Santos <j.santos@orionsys.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Redwood demo + next steps (economic buyer intro)

Hi Joao —

Thanks again for taking the time today — it was great to meet you and walk through how Redwood can help Orion Systems reduce inference cost and stabilize latency for your summarization pipeline. Quick recap from our side:

- Goal: reduce per-call token cost and keep 95th pct latency under 300ms for user-facing flows.
- Value we showed: hybrid routing + prefix caching patterns that cut token spend on repeated prompts by ~30-40% in similar deployments.
- Technical fit: architecture team seemed aligned on model variants and quantization approach, and your engineers liked the runtime observability.

Next steps we discussed:
1) Intro to your economic buyer / budget owner so we can align on pricing and procurement timeline.
2) Share a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a high-level pricing worksheet.
3) Technical deep-dive with your infra lead (optional) to confirm integration details.

Could you please introduce me to the person who owns the budget for this initiative (or confirm I should follow up with procurement)? If easier, feel free to CC them on a reply — I can send a short one-pager + proposed MAP.

I attached a draft MAP and the pricing accelerator worksheet for reference. Proposed times for a 30-min follow-up with pricing: Mon/Tues next week between 9:00–12:00 PT — happy to work around your calendar.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(555) 867-1212

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-Draft.pdf, Redwood-pricing-accelerator.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@orionsys.com>
Cc: Joao Santos <j.santos@orionsys.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:53:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + pricing sync options — Redwood x Orion Systems

Hi Priya —

Thanks for jumping in and nice to meet you (virtually). Joao and I had a short demo on Friday — I attached the MAP and pricing worksheet for context. High level: we help teams reduce unit inference cost via caching, smart routing, and model recommendations while giving engineering teams a single runtime and observability for rollouts.

Quick ask: would you prefer a 20–30 minute pricing/contract overview or a short procurement intake so your team can align internally? We can do either — suggested times: Tue 10:00–10:30 AM ET or Wed 2:00–2:30 PM ET. If those don't work, share a couple windows that do and we'll adapt.

For transparency, our typical timeline for teams of your size is:
- 1 week: pricing and MAP agreement (high-level)
- 2–3 weeks: pilot setup and scoped usage commitments
- 4–6 weeks: pilot execution + initial telemetry review

Alex (cc) will join the pricing sync to walk through the numbers and answer any technical procurement questions.

Thanks — looking forward to your preferred time.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-Draft.pdf, Redwood-pricing-accelerator.xlsx

Looping you in officially. Priya is the budget owner and suggested a pricing sync — she sent two candidate windows (Tue 10:00 ET / Wed 2:00 ET). Can you take Tue 10:00 ET? If not, Wed works too. Please review the attached MAP and pricing workbook before the call (attached). Our ask on the call will be to:

- Confirm procurement cadence and any required approvals (legal/finance timelines)

I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.
